links.comparator_used: Classifier outputting a prediction for every case (baseline overall accuracy 74.4%, no deferral)
links.outcome: Classification accuracy on retained predictions and share of baseline errors captured by deferral
links.effect: At the 85% confidence threshold, accuracy on retained predictions was 90.8% versus 74.4% overall; deferral captured 83.3% of all baseline errors. On external validation, retained accuracy at the same threshold was 72.7%, against a macro F1 of 0.590 for all predictions.
links.tradeoff: Deferred cases need clinician review. The abstract does not report the proportion deferred. The benefit was much smaller on the external dataset.
links.quote: At an 85% confidence threshold, classification accuracy on retained predictions reached 90.8%, while deferral captured 83.3% of all baseline errors.

links.comparator_used: Uncalibrated classifier probabilities before post-hoc temperature scaling
links.outcome: Expected calibration error on the test set
links.effect: Expected calibration error fell from 0.101 to 0.063
links.quote: Temperature scaling reduced test expected calibration error from 0.101 to 0.063.

design_hint: selective prediction deferral threshold and confidence calibration
